name: network_gateway
claim_text: 1. A gateway comprising: a network interface configured to receive packets from a first network; a classifier configured to identify encrypted traffic; and a policy engine configured to block the encrypted traffic based on a user policy.

prior_art_texts.title: Packet gateway
prior_art_texts.abstract: A gateway receives packets and applies policy rules to network traffic.
prior_art_texts.description: [0030] A network interface receives packets from a first network. [0031] A policy engine applies user policy rules to block selected network traffic. [0032] The gateway may classify packet headers.
